findings.title: Name rule (iv) and WEAK_SUPPORT may over-flag CLI output
findings.detail: Flagging any capitalised word not in the stoplist (including sentence-initial words) and requiring 50% content-stem overlap risks false flags on legitimate paraphrase, depressing CLI M1 (>=0.85 holdout). RISK-9 and M1c (<=2%) cover this, but M1c measures hand-written statements, not model phrasing.
findings.recommendation: During implementation, tune stoplist and the 50% threshold on the tune set only, and report CLI M1 failure honestly rather than loosening thresholds without a user decision.

findings.title: Q1-Q4 and D8 thresholds rest on unattended defaults
findings.detail: Q3 states the thresholds are binding but not user-confirmed. This is acknowledged in the brief.
findings.recommendation: Tell the user at delivery that Q1-Q4 were defaults and that any threshold change needs a recorded user decision.
